mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies and a temperature of 71 degrees by the Verona Public Library, though please be aware of an air quality index of 58 today.

The City of Verona has provided updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, noting that underground utility work is complete, and the Verona Senior Center reminds residents that meal orders for their daily programs must be placed in advance.

It is a lively time in our city! Today features live music at Paddy Mac, yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee, while tomorrow offers ART House events and trivia at Hop Haus.

The Verona Police Department released a report stating that on Thursday, October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving, though no students were injured during the incident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so stop by soon to grab a scoop before they close for the evening.
